title: Artist or illustrator
summary: A gallery profile: introduce your practice, give one body of work space, then separate commissions from editions and the full portfolio.

notFor: Studios selling many products (start from small-business)

cards.purpose: Introduce the medium, practice and commission scope before the work.
A named body of work with titles, captions and uncropped proportions.
A clear commission enquiry, with availability only when confirmed.
Editions and the complete portfolio, separate from commissioning.

slots.ask: What name do you want at the top of the page?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji. This appears in the About popover, not beside the name; repeat the essential purpose in the first text card.

slots.ask: What media do you work in, who have you worked for, and do you publish commission prices?
slots.write: One line on their media, then bold-labelled lines. Prices only if they publish them; clients only if they may be named. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What title identifies this body of work? A series name or a short description is enough.
slots.write: Use their supplied series title or a short description of the selected work, at most 100 characters. Replace the demonstration title; if they have no title, omit it. Do not infer a theme from the pictures.

slots.ask: Which six to twelve pieces best show your work now?
slots.write: They upload each piece in the editor. Alt = what the piece shows, from their own description; caption = title, medium, and client or year. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback. Keep each uploaded image’s original aspect ratio, add a descriptive title for the set, and use fit=contain. The images block is schema-supported but not yet shown in the current app; keep the first text card and portfolio links useful without it.

slots.ask: What should people know before taking this action: who it is for, format, timing, price or reply expectations, only if you want to publish them?
slots.write: One or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. Include only facts supplied for this action; do not assume an introductory call is free or that any date, price or reply time is current. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Are you open to commissions? How should people start one?
slots.write: Heading = open or closed, as they say; text = what they take on and response time. Email: Only an address they confirm may be public: everyone can see it. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What short heading should introduce this action?
slots.write: Use a clear heading that describes the action; no unconfirmed availability or promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Where can people see your complete portfolio, or buy prints and originals?
slots.write: Use a label and one useful line for their portfolio or shop; include only their own supplied destinations. Social accounts can use the account URL alone. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a photo, artwork or logo you want to upload as the profile picture?
slots.write: The person uploads their chosen picture in the editor. Never fetch, generate or infer a personal photo. Use their description for alt text wherever the editor asks for it.
